items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for Monday Night Football vs Giants after being listed as a true game-time decision.
items.why: Hip injury; missed practices; Schefter/ETR/Rap confirm official inactive.
items.implication: Targets shift primarily to Davante Adams; secondary options like Parkinson/Mumpfield/Fields see bump. Downgrade Stafford volume.
items.opportunity: Adams primary beneficiary for routes/targets; Kyren Williams receiving work stable.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Zach Ertz signed to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: MRI/tests confirmed sprained MCL; Schefter/Rap joint report.
items.implication: Eagles TE production vacuum short-term; Ertz likely elevated for snaps/routes. Hurts checkdowns affected.
items.opportunity: Ertz or other TEs/RBs for targets; monitor Goedert return window.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib); optimism confirmed. Wear flak if playing.
items.why: Cracked rib; ETR optimism + Schefter/Berry confirm active.
items.implication: Full or near-full routes expected with protection; maintain WR2/3 ranking.
items.opportunity: No major beneficiary shift; docks mild per Levitan/ETR.

items.text: RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive; grab Jonah Coleman as handcuff/beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR not expected + Schefter/Berry confirm.
items.implication: Broncos RB snaps open; Coleman primary add for carries/routes.
items.opportunity: Coleman/J.K. Dobbins or other backs expanded role.

items.text: Chargers placing David Njoku (fibula) and Charlie Kolar (forearm) on IR. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.why: Njoku knee/fibula after 11 snaps; Kolar arm after 42; both IR.
items.implication: TE vacuum; Gadsden primary opportunity for routes/targets with Herbert. McConkey/others unaffected primarily.

items.text: Falcons named Michael Penix Jr. starting QB for Thursday vs Packers; ACL reconstructed ready after splitting reps.
items.implication: Potential offensive upgrade/scheme fit for Bijan/London/Pitts; red-zone drought so far may improve.
items.opportunity: Skill players volume/efficiency bump under Penix.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow and will consult specialists per team protocol. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on fluke fall; imaging + multi-specialist consult.
items.implication: Mariota starts short-term; Commanders offense efficiency and rushing threat drop significantly. McLaurin/Samuel/Deebo targets still viable but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Mariota streamer in deep; handcuff Commanders skill if Daniels multi-week.

items.text: Bears coach Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring pull; will miss some time. Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring; carted off; coach confirmation of missed time.
items.implication: Bagent starts likely Week 3+; Bears pass game efficiency drop; monitor Burden/Odunze/Loveland usage under backup.
items.opportunity: Bagent streaming/DFS if volume; stashes on Bears skill if Williams extended.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12 Bucky. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.why: Clear snap/carry/route separation post-Week 2; committee tilting heavily.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back; Gainwell relegated to change-of-pace. Start Irving with confidence; Gainwell droppable in shallower.
items.opportunity: Irving every-down role expansion including routes/third down.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense weapon-deficient without Brown; Henderson needed for explosiveness.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion/carries up; Stevenson still involved but docked. Both viable but Henderson upside rising.
items.opportunity: Henderson third-down/two-minute/explosive plays; even touch split.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27% and 38% target shares first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead; volume locked in.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 regardless of matchup; high floor/ceiling from opportunity.
items.opportunity: Consistent high target/route share; red-zone viable.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger but hope is minor; he played through it.
items.why: Stinger; played through; MRI today with positive early outlook.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 if minor; monitor practice. No immediate role change.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Germie Bernard expected look with Pittman out.
items.implication: Ravens WR targets to Likely/others; Colts WR to Pierce/Downs/Bernard.
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely, Alec Pierce, Josh Downs elevated.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
items.why: Coach: not serious; available if needed.
items.implication: Expected back full Week 3; minimal missed time.
